prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: a production game distance-impostor texture for the inland background of a Mediterranean seaside resort, not a concept sheet and not a screenshot.
Primary request: a beautiful naturalistic continuous wide panorama of a Mediterranean hillside with scattered authentic small whitewashed and pale limestone villas, weathered terracotta tiled roofs, a few old multi-storey houses, winding narrow lanes, low limestone terraces, olive groves, dark umbrella pines, tall cypresses and green-brown scrub. Replace a crude game backdrop of repetitive box houses with convincing fine real-world detail.
Composition: a single uninterrupted very wide panoramic landscape, approximately 3:1 aspect ratio, ideally 3072 by 1024 or greater detail. View across and slightly upward into the hillside from a resort terrace near sea level. Dense low shrubs and olive foliage along the complete bottom edge; gradually rolling slopes rise behind, then a lower receding soft ridge. Buildings should be small in the landscape, varied and embedded naturally among trees rather than isolated identical toy boxes. No dominant foreground building. Keep the highest skyline around the middle upper half of the canvas with irregular tree silhouettes. The hill descends gently and naturally toward BOTH left and right edges, ending with low distant foliage instead of abruptly chopped buildings. Leave transparent space above the natural skyline. The land itself must be solid opaque, all the way to the complete bottom edge.
Style: genuinely photographic architecture and foliage, premium realistic video game matte painting at distance, convincing natural scale, subtle details and organic irregularity, realistic atmospheric perspective. Soft warm late-afternoon/early-evening diffuse illumination, restrained cream walls, dusty olive greens, muted umber and limestone, cool hazy distant ridges, small subtle warm windows. Avoid orange tint and deep black shadows; the game will supply overall exposure and golden lighting.
Critical texture constraints: genuine transparent alpha background ABOVE the terrain and trees, no painted sky, no solid white background and no checkerboard baked into pixels. One continuous panorama only, no borders, no labels, no text, no split panels, no UI, no foreground resort structures, no people, no cars near camera, no sea and no extra geometry. Do not make a flat facade texture: show a real layered hillside with a coherent varied silhouette.
